name: Pendant of the Sea Lion
summary: At the Shrine of Remulos, druids join the Pendant of the Sea Lion's two halves. The completed talisman marks an initiate's readiness to learn an aquatic form.

sections.title: A Token of the Deep
sections.body: A druid must master the water's dangers to claim the sea lion's aquatic aspect. The pendant has two halves, one embodying the agility to slip past aquatic predators, the other the endurance to withstand prolonged submersion. At the Shrine of Remulos in Moonglade, the pieces are joined into one.

sections.title: Proof of Mastery
sections.body: After the pendant is forged, an initiate brings it to an elder mentor. Turak Runetotem waits on the rises of Thunder Bluff, while Mathrengyl Bearwalker is in Darnassus. The talisman proves the initiate has completed trials under Dendrite Starblaze, allowing the elder to teach the secrets of taking an aquatic form.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Pendant of the Sea Lion?
aliases: what does pendant of the sea lion do
why get pendant of the sea lion
faq.answer: The pendant proves a druid initiate has completed trials of aquatic agility and endurance and is ready to learn an aquatic form.

aliases: how to make sea lion pendant
faq.answer: The pendant's two halves, one for agility and one for endurance, are joined at the Shrine of Remulos in Moonglade.

faq.q: Who do I present the pendant to in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: In Thunder Bluff, you present the completed pendant to Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.

faq.q: Can night elves also earn this pendant?
faq.answer: Yes. Night elf druids undergo the same trial in Moonglade, then bring the assembled pendant to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.

angles.text: As a druid, assembling the pendant marks a milestone in your training. It lets you breathe underwater and swim swiftly as a sea lion.
As a tauren walking the path of the Cenarion Circle, you honor your ancestors and Moonglade's teachings when you bring the pendant to Turak Runetotem.
